links.outcome: Documentation time savings with ambient AI scribe versus dictation, by resident
links.effect: One resident had a significant reduction in documentation time (p < 0.025); a second resident saw essentially no improvement. Benefit was uneven across the two clinicians.
links.quote: One resident saw a statistically significant reduction (p < 0.025) in the time spent on clinical documentation, while a second resident saw essentially no improvement.

screen.reason: Prospective quality improvement pilot evaluating the implementation and utility of an ambient AI scribe (Scribeberry) in outpatient palliative care.
